blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Cyclist fatality rates remain high despite policy support for active travel, and autonomous vehicles add complexity to mixed traffic. Neither crash statistics nor multi-model detection pipelines scale to continuous monitoring of perceived safety along a route. We present an edge-assisted crowdsensing system: handlebar cameras supply street-level frames, a vision-language model (VLM) turns each frame into structured traffic attributes through a single prompt, and an explainable boosting machine (EBM) combines them with OpenStreetMap road infrastructure and on-bike kinematics to predict a crowdsourced 1-9 safety score. Extraction belongs at the network edge: the fastest self-hosted model needs 2.49 s per frame and scoring takes 0.4 ms on a CPU. On 1,362 annotated frames from two London routes, the EBM regressor reaches 72.2 percent binary accuracy and a mean absolute error of 1.011 under five-fold cross-validation. It is within one accuracy point of black-box ensembles. Its per-feature shape functions give exact attribution: physical lane separation is worth +0.97 rating points, a painted lane +0.70 and a construction site -0.65. Planners can therefore price an infrastructure change in rating points, and the results enter cost-benefit analysis directly. We also report inter-annotator agreement (alpha = 0.4695), an attribute audit, and a sensitivity analysis linking attribute error to accuracy. With re-encoding, a 20 s sampling interval serves 1,000 riders at 54 Mbit/s at a cost of 1.4 accuracy points, making continuous monitoring practical.
blocks.zh: 尽管政策支持积极旅行,但自行车队的死亡率仍然很高,自主车辆增加了混合交通的复杂性。 既无坠机统计,也无多模式检测管道,无法持续监测沿途的安全感。 我们提出了一个边缘辅助的拥塞系统:手提箱摄像头提供街机级帧,一个视觉语言模型(VLM)通过单一的提示器将每个帧转化为结构化的交通属性,一个可解释的助推机(EBM)将其与OpenStreetMap路基建和骑动车手结合,以预测一个拥塞源1-9安全分数. 提取器属于网络边缘:最快的自装机型每帧需要2.49 s,积分在CPU上需要0.4ms. 在来自两条伦敦路线的1,362个注释框上,EBM递归器达到了72.2%的二进制精度,在5倍交叉验证下,平均绝对误差为1.011. 它在一个精确点 黑盒组合。 其每个地貌的形状功能给出了确切的归属:物理道分离值+0.97的评分点,一个漆色道+0.70和建筑工地−0.65. 因此,规划人员可以定价改变评级点的基础设施,结果直接输入成本效益分析。 我们还报告说明人之间的协议(alpha=0.4695),属性审计,以及将属性错误与准确性联系起来的敏感性分析. 通过重新编码,一个20s的采样间隔以54 Mbit/s的速度为1000个骑手服务,花费1.4的精确点,使得持续监测变得切实可行.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Cycling brings well-documented environmental, health and economic co-benefits [ 1 ] . Yet urban road networks were designed around motorised transport, exposing cyclists to high vehicle volumes and large speed differentials with little physical protection. Autonomous vehicles add further complexity, raising new safety challenges for vulnerable road users [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 自行车带来有充分记录的环境、健康和经济共同效益 [一]. 然而,城市道路网的设计围绕着机动车运输,使骑行者暴露在车辆量大和速度差大而几乎没有实物保护的情况下。 自主车辆进一步复杂化,给弱势道路使用者带来了新的安全挑战[2].

blocks.en: Crash statistics capture only part of the problem. Perceived safety is how safe a cyclist feels . It shapes route choice and ridership at least as strongly as objective risk [ 3 , 4 ] . Questionnaire surveys [ 5 ] do not scale to continuous route-level monitoring, and vision pipelines [ 6 ] treat safety as an objective property of the scene. Neither approach measures perceived safety along a route.
blocks.zh: 崩溃统计只捕捉了问题的一部分. 安全感是自行车手的感受 它塑造路线选择和骑行至少与客观风险一样强烈。 问卷调查[5]没有规模化为持续的路线级别监测,而远景管线[6]将安全视为现场的客观财产. 无论是哪种方法都无法衡量沿途的安全性。

blocks.en: Continuous measurement is a mobile crowdsensing problem because the riders carry the sensors and the riders make the judgement. The VLM that describes each scene belongs at the network edge, and downstream stages see only its compact structured output. Mobile edge generation (MEG) formalises this split for generative models: the model runs at the edge and only a sketch is transmitted [ 7 , 8 ] . The cost of such a measurement lies in uplink, edge compute and sampling rate, and any saving on them has to be weighed against accuracy. This paper contributes:
blocks.zh: 持续测量是一个移动拥挤的问题,因为骑手携带传感器,骑手做出判断. 描述每个场景的VLM属于网络边缘,下游阶段只看到其紧凑的结构输出. 移动边缘生成(MEG)将这种分出形式化为基因模型:模型运行于边缘并只传递出一幅草图[7,8]. 这种测量的成本在于上行链路、边缘计算和取样率,任何节省都必须与准确性相权衡。 本文提供了:

blocks.en: • An edge-deployable crowdsensing pipeline that turns handlebar video into structured traffic attributes through a single vision–language model (VLM) prompt and fuses them with OpenStreetMap (OSM) road infrastructure and rider kinematics. The prompt replaces a specialised multi-model detection pipeline, and the extraction stage fits in 9.2 GB of GPU memory on open-weight models, so it can be hosted on a roadside or edge server with only the attribute vector sent onward. • An interpretable scoring stage built on an explainable boosting machine (EBM). It runs in 0.4 ms on a CPU and can run at any tier of the system. It matches the black-box baselines to within one accuracy point and gives planners per-feature contributions in rating points. • A per-stage deployment budget for city-scale operation , measuring uplink, edge compute and sampling rate: re-encoding cuts the payload 23 × \times , and a 20 s interval serves a 1,000-rider fleet at 54 Mbit/s at a cost of 1.4 accuracy points.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Mobile crowdsensing and edge inference. Mobile crowdsensing treats participant-carried sensing as a systems problem in which coverage, participant burden and uplink cost are design variables [ 9 , 10 ] . Karakaya et al. [ 11 ] treat cycling-surface sensing this way, splitting processing between rider phones and the cloud. Serving large vision–language models at the network edge is an active research area [ 12 ] , and MEG places the generative model itself at the edge so that only compact sketches traverse the network [ 7 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 移动人群和边缘推论。 移动集聚将参与者携带的感知视为一个系统问题,其中涵盖范围、参与者负担和上行成本是设计变量[9,10]. 卡拉卡亚等. [11] 以这种方式处理循环-地表感应,在骑手手机和云之间分出处理. 服务于网络边缘的大型视觉-语言模型是一个活跃的研究领域[12],MEG将基因模型本身置于边缘,这样只有紧凑的草图能穿越网络[7,8].

blocks.en: Cycling safety assessment. Recent reviews address cyclist safety broadly [ 13 ] and perceived safety in particular [ 14 ] . Chataway et al. [ 4 ] find that infrastructure quality shapes how cyclists interpret risk. Questionnaires measure perceived risk under varying conditions [ 3 , 5 ] , but they scale poorly and cannot resolve variation along a route. Crash databases [ 15 ] record outcomes only and cannot separate objective risk from subjective experience.
blocks.zh: 自行车安全评估. 最近的审查广泛涉及自行车安全[13],特别是据认为的安全[14]。 查塔韦等. [4] 发现基础设施质量如何塑造自行车手如何解释风险. 问卷在不同条件下衡量所意识到的风险[3,5],但范围差,无法解决沿途的变化。 崩溃数据库[15]只记录结果,不能将客观风险与主观经验区分开来.

blocks.en: Sensing and vision for scene-level safety. Street-level imagery has been used to score bikeability [ 16 ] , to rate cycling safety from geospatial and visual cues [ 17 ] and to relate perceived safety to accident records [ 18 ] . Costa et al. [ 6 ] rank environments by pairwise image comparison, and the ranking does not identify which scene elements drive it. Christie et al. [ 19 ] link helmet-mounted video to near-miss frequency, and Chiang et al. [ 20 ] release an ego-view cyclist dataset; both motivate the on-bike design. Wang et al. [ 21 ] enrich Global Positioning System (GPS) trajectories with road-network context, and we build on the same route-level fusion.
blocks.zh: 场景安全感知与视野. 街道图象被用来评分可骑性[16],从地理空间和视觉提示来评分自行车安全性[17],并将感知的安全性与事故记录[18]联系起来. 科斯塔等编. [6] 通过对等图像比较来排名环境,排名没有识别出哪个场景元素驱动它. 克丽丝蒂等. [19] 将头盔挂起的视频连接到近失频频率,而Chiang等. [20] 发布自负-视图循环数据集;两者都激发了骑自行车的设计. 王等编. [21] 以道路网络为背景来丰富全球定位系统的轨迹,我们基于同样的路线级聚变。

blocks.en: Explainable AI in transportation. Post-hoc saliency methods explain predictions at the pixel level, whereas planners work with per-variable quantities. Generalised additive models (GAMs) [ 22 ] and their boosted variant the EBM [ 23 ] give inherently interpretable predictions and have been applied to cycling demand [ 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 交通方面的解释性AI. 后热分量法解释了像素级的预测,而规划者则以可变量工作. 通用添加剂模型[22]及其增强变体EBM[23]给出了内在可解释的预测,并已应用于循环需求[24]。

blocks.en: VLMs for structured scene understanding. Vision–language pre-training such as Contrastive Language–Image Pre-training (CLIP) [ 25 ] gives strong zero-shot transfer to new visual domains. However, traffic applications have targeted open-ended question answering and narration [ 26 ] , and downstream modelling needs structured extraction. We use structured prompting to extract safety-relevant scene attributes as JavaScript Object Notation (JSON), which replaces a specialised multi-model detection pipeline with a single maintainable query. Section III-B validates the resulting attributes against human labels.
blocks.zh: 用于结构化场景理解的VLM. 视觉-语言预训如相對語-相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相對相相對相對相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 然而,交通应用已经针对开放式问题回答和叙述[26],下游建模需要结构化提取. 我们使用结构化的提示来提取与安全相关的场景属性作为JavaScript Object Notation(JSON),它用单一可维护的查询取代了专门的多模型检测管. 第三-B节对照人类标签验证由此产生的属性.

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Three-stage pipeline: data preparation, VLM-based traffic description at the network edge, and EBM-based safety modelling with interpretable analysis.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1: 三相管线:数据制备,网络边缘以VLM为主的流量描述,以及有可解释分析的以EBM为主的安全建模.

blocks.en: Fig. 1 summarises the pipeline in three stages: capture on the bicycle, attribute extraction at the network edge, and scoring wherever the attribute vector is consumed.
blocks.zh: 图一概括了管道分三个阶段:在自行车上捕获,在网络边缘提取属性,在消耗属性矢量的任何地方打分.

blocks.en: III-A Data Collection and Safety Scoring
blocks.zh: III-A 数据收集和安全分类

blocks.en: Two cyclists rode two London routes with handlebar-mounted GoPro cameras that log video, inertial data and GPS fixes. Route A covers 11 km near Queen Mary University of London and Route B 2.9 km in Farringdon. We sampled one frame every five seconds, yielding 1,419 usable frames after quality filtering (1,220 from Route A, 199 from Route B), each 5312 × \times 2988 pixels and a 3.13 MB payload. Thirty-two recordings span 21.9 km along-track: 19.1 km on Route A over 28 recordings that revisit the same streets, and 2.8 km on Route B over four. The 1,362 frames carrying a GPS fix form the modelling set, a density of 62.3 frames per rider-kilometre.
blocks.zh: 两名骑自行车的骑手骑着两条伦敦路线,上面装有手提杆的GoPro相机记录了视频,惯性数据和GPS修正. A路位于伦敦玛丽女王大学附近11公里处,而B路则位于法林登. 我们每5秒钟取样一帧,在质量过滤后产生1,419个可用相框(A道1,220个,B道199个),每帧5312×相像素2988个,有效载荷3.13个MB. 32个录音跨道21.9公里:A道19.1公里,28个录音重访同道;B道2.8公里,4个。 搭载GPS固定装置的1,362个帧构成建模集,密度为每克62.3个帧.

blocks.en:

They were screened for cycling at least three times a week and sampled across age groups. Annotators supplied 7,045 ratings over the 1,252 frames for which per-annotator records were retained (5.63 ratings per frame on average, median 5, range 1–29); 1,165 of those frames were rated twice or more and 87 exactly once. The ground-truth score y y for each frame is the mean of its available ratings, and we derive a binary label with a threshold τ = 5 \tau=5 : c i = { 1 y i > τ , 0 otherwise, c_{i}=\begin{cases}1&y_{i}>\tau,\\

The resulting dataset is near-balanced: of the 1,362 frames in the modelling set, 45.2% are labelled safe and 54.8% unsafe. Averaged scores have a median of 4.88 and quartiles of 4.00 and 6.14, a slight skew towards the unsafe side. The quartiles bracket τ = 5 \tau=5 , so the boundary falls inside the middle 50% of the data and splits the classes more evenly than a cut into either tail.

blocks.en: Agreement and rater profile. Over the multiply-rated frames, Krippendorff’s α \alpha under an ordinal difference function is 0.4695 with a 95% confidence interval (CI) of [0.4361, 0.4985], and the median across-annotator variance is 1.25. Agreement is moderate, as expected for a judgement that depends on individual risk tolerance, and it is the reason we model the mean rating. Familiarity also shifts ratings. On the 980 frames rated both by annotators who had ridden the location and by annotators who had not, a within-frame paired comparison shows that familiarity lowers the rating by 0.121 points (95% CI [0.031, 0.208]).
blocks.zh: 协议与评分简介. 在乘法下,Krippendorff的α-α在正弦差函数下为0.4695,95%的置信间隔(CI)为[0.4361,0.4985],中位跨标差为1.25. 协议是温和的,对取决于个人风险容忍度的判断是期待的,这也是我们模拟平均评级的原因。 熟悉度也会改变收视率。 在980帧的评分上,既有经过该地的注释人评分,也有没有经过该地的注释人评分,一个框内对等的比较显示,熟悉度将评分降低了0.121分(95% CI [0.031,0.208]).

blocks.en: III-B Multimodal Feature Extraction
blocks.zh: 三-B 多式联运特征提取

blocks.en: VLM-based traffic attributes. For each frame we issued a single prompt to Grok-2-Vision-1212 requesting a structured JSON response, and the model returned 14 attributes. Five enter the models: cycling lane, lane separation, construction site, immediate crash risk from traffic and high traffic density. The rest cover intersections, traffic signals, buses, pedestrians, surface wetness, parks and visibility, and none of them is a model input. Table I compares three VLMs against human-audited ground truth on six visually verifiable attributes. Grok-2-Vision reaches the highest average accuracy (66.7%) at the lowest per-token cost and supplies every attribute used below.
blocks.zh: VLM 基于流量属性. 对于每个帧,我们向Grok-2-Vision-1212发出单个提示,要求一个结构化的JSON响应,模型返回了14个属性. 五入道:自行车道,分道行走,施工现场,交通即刻发生相撞风险和交通密度高. 其余的覆盖路口,交通信号,公交车,行人,地表湿润,公园和能见度,无一是模型输入. 页:1 我比较了3个VLM 与人审计的地面真相 在6个可视可核查的属性。 Grok-2-Vision达到最高平均精度(66.7%),以最低的每桶成本和提供下文使用的每个属性。

blocks.en: TABLE I: VLM comparison on human-audited attributes (% accuracy) and per-token price, with the always-absent baseline for the three attributes that carry corpus-wide labels.
blocks.zh: 表一:人审计属性(%精度)和每桶价格的VLM比较,始终标有全实体标签的三个属性的基线.

blocks.en: Attribute audit. Three of the six attributes carry corpus-wide human labels on 1,362 frames, and comparison against the always-absent baseline in Table I shows which of them can be trusted. Cycling lane and lane separation clear their baselines by 16.6 and 5.9 points, and we retain both. Intersection does not: at 53.5% it falls below its 85.6% baseline, because the extractor reports an intersection in 57.1% of frames against a human rate of 14.4%. We exclude it from every model. The same over-reporting affects the two retained attributes more mildly. The extractor marks them present in 43.2% and 25.0% of frames, against human rates of 33.0% and 19.6%. We audited the other three on a sample only, so they carry no baseline. Section IV-C bounds the cost of residual attribute error.
blocks.zh: 属性审计. 在6个属性中,有3个属性在1 362个框上标有全体的人类标签,与表一中始终存在的基线进行比较,显示哪些特征可以被信任。 自行车道和分道通航线以16.6分和5.9分清理了基线,我们保留了这两点。 截面没有:53.5%的截面低于其85.6%的基线,因为提取器报告57.1%的帧相交,而人的比例为14.4%。 我们从每个模型中排除它。 同样的多报对这两个保留属性的影响更轻微. 提取器显示它们存在于43.2%和25.0%的相框中,而人类的比率分别为33.0%和19.6%。 我们只审计了另外三个样本,所以没有基准。 第四-C节限定了剩余属性出错的成本.

blocks.en: OSM road infrastructure. We map-matched GPS-tagged frames to the OSM road network by projecting each onto the nearest candidate road segment; the largest matched distance was 46.4 m. We aggregated the OSM road class ( highway ) to six levels, giving route-level context independent of the frames. The residual other level covers 46.9% of Route A.
blocks.zh: OSM公路基础设施. 我们绘制了与GSM公路网相匹配的GPS标记框架,将每个框架投射到最近的候选公路段;相匹配的最大距离为46.4米。 我们把OSM公路等级(高速公路)合并到6个等级,使路线级别的背景独立于框架。 其余的一级占A道的46.9%。

blocks.en: Kinematic features. GoPro inertial metadata provides three-dimensional speed ( speed3d ) and acceleration ( accl3d ), capturing dynamics the frames cannot show. Eight features enter the models: the five attributes named above, the aggregated road class, and the two kinematic channels.
blocks.zh: 动脉特征. GoPro惯性元数据提供三维速度(speed3d)和加速度(accl3d),捕获帧无法显示的动态. 8个特征入模型:上面所命名的5个属性,汇总道类,和两个动能道.

blocks.en: III-C Explainable Boosting Machine
blocks.zh: III-C 解释式助推机

blocks.en: We adopt EBMs [ 23 ] , which extend GAMs [ 22 ] with gradient boosting over shallow decision trees and a small set of selected pairwise interaction terms: g ⁡ ( 𝔼 ⁡ [ Y ∣ 𝐱 ] ) = β 0 + ∑ j = 1 p f j ​ ( x j ) + ∑ i < j f i ​ j ​ ( x i , x j ) . g\!\left(\mathbb{E}[Y\mid\mathbf{x}]\right)=\beta_{0}+\sum_{j=1}^{p}f_{j}(x_{j})+\sum_{i<j}f_{ij}(x_{i},x_{j}). (2) Here Y Y is the target, the score y ∈ [ 1 , 9 ] y\in[1,9] for regression and the binary label c c for classification. The vector 𝐱 \mathbf{x} holds the p = 8 p=8 features, β 0 \beta_{0} is the intercept, and g ⁡ ( ⋅ ) g(\cdot) is the link, the identity for regression and the logit for classification. Each f j f_{j} is a univariate shape function learned by boosting single-feature residuals. The terms f i ​ j f_{ij} capture pairwise effects, with candidate pairs selected by interaction strength [ 23 ] . The regressor minimises mean squared error and the classifier minimises cross-entropy. Each term in Eq. ( 2 ) plots as a shape function that shows how a feature raises or lowers the predicted score, and the attribution is read directly from the fitted terms.
blocks.zh: 我们采用 EBMs [23] , 将 GAMS [22] 延伸至浅层决策树上并有梯度提升, 以及一组选定的双向交互术语: g = (E = [Y = x]) = β 0 + ∑ j = 1 p f j (x j ) + i < j i (x i , x j )!\ 左 (\ mathbb{ E} [Y\mid\ mathb{x}}\ \ \ beta = 0 sum j = 1 }^{p} f_{j} (x sum_{i} (x_{i ), x_{j}) 。 (2)这里Y Y是目标,分数y [1,9]y\in [1,9] 回归和二进制标签c的分级. 向量 x\ mathbf{x} 持有 p = 8 p=8 特性, β 0\ beta_{0} 为截取, g → (\) g (\) (\ cdot) 是链接, 回归的特性和分类的登录 。 每个fj f_{j}是一个通过增强单地层残基所学出的统一形状函数. f i j f i j j ) 捕获对等效果,由交互强度选择候选对 [23]. 后退器最小化为平方误差,而分级器最小化为交叉纵横. Eq. (2)地块中的每个名词作为形状函数,显示一个特性如何提高或降低所预测的分数,归属直接从所配置的名词读取.

blocks.en: Protocol and settings. We evaluated all models by five-fold cross-validation over the GPS-tagged frames, using KFold with shuffling and random_state =42. Each fold holds 272–273 test frames. Folds are not stratified, so class balance varies across folds: the safe share spans 0.404–0.484. Seed 1 governs model-internal randomness. We fixed every setting in advance, so no model was tuned against the evaluation data. The configurations are EBM at the defaults of the interpret library; logistic regression max_iter =1000; decision tree max_depth =5; random forest 200 trees, max_depth =8; XGBoost 200 trees, max_depth =4, learning rate 0.05. The EBM consumes raw features; the remaining models use label encoding with median imputation, and the encoder and imputer are fitted on training folds only.
blocks.zh: 协议和设置。 我们用五倍的交叉验证 来评估所有模型 在GPS标记的框上, 使用 KFold 与打乱和随机_状态=42。 每个折叠都持有272–273个测试帧. 折叠不分级,因此不同折叠的类别平衡不一:安全份额为0.404–0.484. 种子 1 规范模型-内部随机性. 我们提前确定了所有设置,所以没有模型可以对照评价数据。 配置为:解释库默认时的EBM;逻辑回归max_iter=1000;决定树max_深度=5;随机森林200棵树,max_深度=8;XGBoost 200树,max_深度=4;学习率0.05. EBM消耗了原始特性;其余的型号使用带有中位值的标签编码,而编码器和入子只被安装在训练折叠上.

blocks.en: IV Results
blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en: IV-A Exploratory Feature Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-A 探索特征分析

blocks.en: Kinematic features. Perceived safety increases with cycling speed up to approximately 4 m/s and then declines at higher values. Annotators rated still images and never saw rider speed, so the curve reflects the infrastructure that permits higher speeds.
blocks.zh: 动脉特征. 感知到的安全性会随着循环速度的提高而提高到大约4 m/s,然后以更高的值下降. 注释者评为静态图像,从未见过骑手速度,因此曲线反映了允许更高速度的基础设施.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Mean safety score for each combination of cycling infrastructure (column groups: cycling lane present, cycling lane separation) and adverse condition (row panels: construction site, crash risk from traffic, intersection). Each cell gives the mean score and the proportion of observations in brackets. The no-infrastructure, no-hazard cell of each column group is the baseline, and every other cell adds its signed change from it.
blocks.zh: 发相. 2:循环基础设施每组合(栏组:存在循环道,循环道分离)和不利条件(行板:施工现场、交通造成的相撞风险、相交点)的平均安全分数。 每个单元格给出正分分和括号中观察的比例. 每个列组的无基础设施,无危险细胞是基线,而其他每个细胞都从中加入其签名变化.

blocks.en: Feature combination analysis. Fig. 2 shows mean scores for cycling infrastructure combined with three adverse conditions. Construction sites show the strongest negative contrast, about − 1.0 -1.0 points even where physical separation is present. Separation reduces the penalty for immediate crash risk from traffic to − 0.1 -0.1 points, compared with − 0.3 -0.3 under lane marking alone. A physical barrier reduces perceived danger beyond what lane marking alone achieves. Intersections cost about 0.2 points regardless of infrastructure.
blocks.zh: 特色组合分析. 图2显示循环基础设施的平均分数加上三种不利条件。 建筑工地呈现出最强烈的负面对比,即使存在物理分离,大约为-1.0-1.0分. 与单道道标下的0.3-0.3分相比,隔离将交通流量造成的即时相撞风险的处罚降至-0.1-0.1分。 有形障碍物可减少仅标出一条道以外的危险。 无论基础设施如何,交叉点都花费了约0.2分。

blocks.en: Categorical feature ranking. Ranking the binary attributes by the raw contrast Δ = mean Yes − mean No \Delta=\mathrm{mean}_{\text{Yes}}-\mathrm{mean}_{\text{No}} agrees in direction with the combinations above. Cycling lane separation ( Δ > 1.0 \Delta>1.0 ) and lane presence show the largest positive contrasts, while construction sites and immediate crash risk show the largest negative ones ( Δ < − 0.4 \Delta<-0.4 ). These contrasts are marginal; the additive model of Section IV-D conditions on the remaining features.
blocks.zh: 分类特征排名. 用原始对比 = 表示是 = 表示不是 = 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示 表示= 表示= 表示= 表示 表示 表示= 表示= 表示 表示= 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 表示 。 自行车道分离(QQ > 1.0\德尔塔 > 1.0)和车道存在表现出最大的正比,而建筑工地和即时相撞风险则显示出最大的负比(QQ < − 0.4\德尔塔 <-0.4). 这些对比度是边际的;第四节-D部分关于剩余特征条件的添加剂模型.

blocks.en: IV-B Model Performance
blocks.zh: 四-B 模型性能

blocks.en: Classification. We compare the EBM with two interpretable baselines, logistic regression and a decision tree, and with two black-box references, a random forest and XGBoost. Table II reports the binary task under random five-fold cross-validation. Among interpretable models the EBM regressor attains the highest accuracy (72.2%) and weighted F1 (0.719), 5.7 points above logistic regression. It is within 1.0 point of both XGBoost (71.5%) and random forest (73.2%). Section IV-C shows that no model pair separates under a tighter protocol. The EBM regressor’s unsafe-class recall (0.815) exceeds its safe-class recall (0.623), so it errs on the side of caution.
blocks.zh: 分类 我们比较EBM与两个可解释的基线,物流回归和一棵决策树,以及两个黑盒参考,一个随机森林和XGBoost. 表二在随机五倍交叉验证下报告二进制任务. 在可解释模型中,EBM递归器的精度最高(72.2%),加权F1 (0.719),高于物流递归5.7分。 它在XGBoost(71.5%)和随机森林(73.2%)的1.0分之内。 第四-C节显示,没有模型对按照更严格的协议进行分离. EBM的不安全级召回(0.815)超过了安全级召回(0.623),因此在谨慎方面是错误的。

blocks.en: TABLE II: Model comparison for binary safety classification under random five-fold cross-validation. Differences of about one point at this sample size do not establish an ordering; see Section IV-C .
blocks.zh: 表格 二:随机五倍交叉验证下二元安全分类模型比较. 在这种样本大小上,大约1分的差异不能确定订单;见第四节-C节。

blocks.en: Regression. The EBM regressor achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.011 and a root-mean-square error of 1.303 on the 1–9 scale, so the average prediction error is about one point. Within-tolerance accuracy reaches approximately 60% at ± 1 \pm 1 and 87% at ± 2 \pm 2 . The median annotation variance is 1.25, so two individual raters routinely differ by more than a point. The target is a mean of several ratings and correspondingly less noisy, so ± 2 \pm 2 is a practical tolerance.
blocks.zh: 后退相还. EBM后退器实现1.011的正绝对误差(MAE)和1–9的比分上为1.303的根-正正方位误差,所以平均预测误差约为一分. 在±1\pm1时,内容忍度精度达到约60%,在±2\pm2时,则达到87%. 中位注相差为1.25分,因此两个个体的分分数通常相差超过一分. 目标为数个收视率的平均值并相应减少噪音,因此±2\pm 2是实用的容忍.

blocks.en: IV-C Robustness: Spatial Blocking and Attribute Noise
blocks.zh: IV-C 强性:空间阻塞和属性噪音

blocks.en: Samples from a moving sensor are spatially autocorrelated. Frames five seconds apart along a route are near-duplicates, so random folds can place almost identical frames in training and test. To quantify how much this inflates accuracy, we re-ran every model under a second five-fold protocol differing only in grouping. We cut each recording into contiguous 200 m along-track blocks, 124 in total, and formed folds with GroupKFold so that no block spans the train/test boundary; we call this spatial blocking. We assigned blocks from coordinates alone, before fitting any transformation. Neither protocol stratifies, so grouping is the only manipulated difference. Spatial blocking widens the per-fold safe share to 0.335–0.531, against 0.404–0.484 under random folds.
blocks.zh: 移动传感器的样本在空间上与自动相关。 沿一条路线相隔5秒的帧是相近重复的,因此随机折叠可以在训练和测试中放置几乎相同的帧. 为了量化这种夸大精度的精度,我们重新将每个模型放在第二个五倍协议下,只在分组上有所不同。 我们把每张录音剪成相接200米的沿轨区块,总共124个,并与GroupKFold形成折叠,这样没有区块跨越列车/测试边界;我们称之为这个空间屏蔽. 我们从坐标上划出块 然后再进行任何改变 两个协议都没有分级,所以分组是唯一被操纵的区别. 空间屏蔽将每倍安全份额扩大至0.335–0.531,随机折叠下为0.404–0.484.

blocks.en: Measured accuracy is higher under random folds for five of the six models. Under frame-paired comparison, the gain is 3.7 points for random forest (95% CI [1.8, 5.7], Holm p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) and 2.6 points for the EBM regressor ([0.8, 4.7], p = 0.004 p=0.004 ). The remaining gains are too small for the test to resolve, and logistic regression shows none, since a linear model cannot exploit near-duplicate neighbours. Under spatial blocking, no pair of models separates in any of the 15 exact McNemar tests with Holm correction. The ordering in Table II is therefore not a ranking, and its accuracy level holds for the random-fold protocol that produced it.
blocks.zh: 6个模型中的5个模型在随机折叠下测量精度较高. 在帧比对下,随机森林的得分是3.7分(95% CI [1.8, 5.7], Holm p < 0.001 p < 0.001]),EBM递减器的得分是2.6分([0.8, 4.7],p = 0.004 p= 0.004 ) 。 剩下的得分太小,无法解决,物流回归也没有,因为线性模型无法利用近似重复的邻居。 在空间阻隔下,在15个精确的麦克尼马尔测试中,没有一对模型与霍尔姆修正分离. 因此,表二中的顺序不是排名,其准确度维持了生成该顺序的随机倍数协议。

blocks.en: An end-to-end baseline. On the same spatially blocked folds, a linear probe on CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings does not separate from the EBM (Holm p = 0.3676 p=0.3676 over seven regularisation settings), so the comparison is unresolved at this sample size. Its best setting leads by 2.6 points, and that setting was chosen on the evaluation folds. The probe also has no additive attributions.
blocks.zh: 端到端基线. 在同一空间被屏蔽的折叠上,CLIP VIT-L/14嵌入式上的一个线性探测器与EBM(Holm p=0.3676 p=0.3676在7个正则设置上)不相分离,因此比较在这个样本大小上是无法解决的. 其最佳设置领先2.6分,该设置被选择在评价折叠上. 探测器也没有添加剂的归属.

blocks.en: Attribute noise. Corrupting the five VLM inputs at rate p p and retraining under spatial blocking degrades accuracy roughly linearly, by about 3.3 points per ten points of added attribute error, reaching 9.8 points at p = 0.30 p=0.30 . The five inputs average 69.4% accuracy in Table I , so their 30.6% error rate is already at the top of the swept range. Attribute quality is the main limit on accuracy here. The model tolerates that error because it combines several weak, partly independent cues and depends on none of them alone.
blocks.zh: 属性噪声. 5个VLM输入以p速率进行腐蚀,在空间阻隔下再培训,精确度大致呈线性下降,每10个新增属性误差约降低3.3分,在p=0.30p=0.30时达到9.8分. 表一的5个输入值平均准确度为69.4%,因此其30.6%的误差率已经排在被扫荡范围的首位. 属性质量是这里精度的主要限制. 模型可以容忍这个错误,因为它结合了几个弱而部分独立的提示,并且仅依靠其中任何一个.

blocks.en: IV-D Feature Importance and Explainability
blocks.zh: 四-D 特性重要性和可解释性

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Global feature importance from the EBM, as the mean absolute weighted score. Every main-effect term outranks every pairwise interaction term.
blocks.zh: 图3:EBM的全球特色重要性,作为平均绝对加权分. 每个主效应名词的分数都高于每个对等互动名词.

blocks.en: As Fig. 3 shows, individual shape functions dominate pairwise interaction terms in mean absolute contribution. In descending order, the five most influential features are physically separated cycling lane, painted cycling lane, cyclist acceleration, cyclist speed and construction site.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,单个形状函数以平均绝对贡献的对等交互术语为主. 按降序排列,最具影响力的五个特征是:物理上分离的自行车道,被漆的自行车道,自行车加速道,自行车快道和施工地.

blocks.en: On the rating scale, physical separation is worth + 0.97 +0.97 points and a painted lane + 0.70 +0.70 , while a construction site costs 0.65 points. A construction site reduces the benefit of protective infrastructure but does not cancel it. Road class has the widest marginal contrast of any categorical feature ( Δ = 1.52 \Delta=1.52 ), but ranks below these inside the model. Across 150 bootstrap resamples of the 124 spatial blocks, the two cycling-lane terms appear in the top three every time. Road class, construction and speed exchange positions, so we treat those three as one tier.
blocks.zh: 在评分等级上,物理分离值为+0.97+0.97分,并设有被涂道+0.70+0.70分,而施工工地成本为0.65分. 建筑工地减少保护性基础设施的效益,但不会取消. 道路级具有任何绝对特征(QQ = 1.52\Delta = 1.52)中最最宽的边际对比,但在模型内这些位置以下. 在124个空间区块的150个靴子上,两个环形跑道术语每次都出现在前三. 道路等级,建筑和速度交换位置, 所以我们把这三层当作一层。

blocks.en: V Deployment Budget: Uplink, Compute and Sampling
blocks.zh: 五. 部署预算:上行、计算和取样

blocks.en: City-scale monitoring is constrained less by accuracy than by uplink and compute cost. Scoring a frame with the trained EBM takes 0.4 ms on CPU; the fastest VLM configuration needs 2.49 s on an A100-80GB, a factor of roughly 6,000. Extraction should therefore be offloaded, as in mobile edge computing [ 28 ] and in recent work on vision–language inference at the edge [ 12 ] . In MEG terms the attribute vector is the sketch, and downstream stages work from it without running the heavy model [ 7 ] . In the proposed deployment each frame enters the edge as a 0.13 MB re-encoded image and leaves it as a 14-field JSON record.
blocks.zh: 城市规模监测受精度限制的程度低于上行链路和计算成本。 与训练有素的EBM相接的帧需要0.4 ms在CPU上;最快的VLM配置需要2.49 s在A100-80GB上,这个系数大约为6000. 因此,应该卸下提取物,例如移动边计算[28]和最近关于边上视觉-语言推论的工作[12]。 在MEG术语中,属性向量是草图,下游阶段从中工作而不运行重模型[7]. 在提议的部署中,每个帧作为0.13 MB重新编码的图像进入边缘,并留作14战地JSON记录.

blocks.en: TABLE III: Self-hosted extraction on a 309-frame stratified subset (A100-80GB, bf16, batch 1, 1024 px long edge). Accuracies are on cycling lane and lane separation, the two attributes the audit retains.
blocks.zh: 表三:在309帧分层子集(A100-80GB,bf16, 第1批,1024px长边)上自发地取出. 权限在自行车道和车道分离,审计保留的两个属性.

blocks.en: Self-hosted extraction. A commercial endpoint charges per frame and requires rider video and GPS to leave the operator’s control. Table III benchmarks five open-weight VLMs. Accuracy on cycling lane is comparable to the commercial extractor’s, and accuracy does not rise with model size. The 4B model exceeds the 32B by 8.7 points on cycling lane (Holm p = 0.0036 p=0.0036 ) at 3.3 × \times the speed in one-seventh the memory. On lane separation all five are close to the 80.4% always-absent baseline of Table I , so only the cycling-lane column discriminates. Fifteen paired tests cover five models and the three attributes with corpus-wide labels at both input resolutions. The 1024 px input is favoured in seven and native capture in none. These extractors suit a new deployment; checking equivalent downstream attribution would require re-extracting the corpus.
blocks.zh: 自营取出. 每帧商业终点收费,要求骑手视频和GPS离开运营商的控制. 表 三 基准 5 个公开加权的自愿酰胺。 自行车道上的精确度与商业提取器的精确度相当,准确度不会随模型大小而上升. 4B型在回旋道上超过32B8.7分(Holm p = 0.0036 p = 0.0036),以3.3××乘以内存一分之七的速度. 在车道分离时,所有5个车道都接近表一的80.4%始终没有的基线,因此只有自行车道柱存在歧视. 15个对接测试覆盖了5个模型和3个属性,在两个输入分辨率上都有全元标签. 1024px输入在7个中首选,而原生捕获则无. 这些提取器适合新的部署;检查等同的下游归属需要重新取出核弹。

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Sampling interval against accuracy under spatial blocking, with the uplink each interval implies relative to 5 s capture on the same axis. Shading marks the fold-to-fold spread of the 5 s baseline. The size-matched control keeps the 5 s cadence while using the same number of frames as the thinned setting. Bars span folds.
blocks.zh: 发相. 4:在空间屏蔽下对精确度进行取样间隔,每个上行链路意味着相较于同一轴上的5 s捕获. 遮放标志了5 s 基线的折叠相向分布. 大小相配的控制器保持了5 s 的凸起,同时使用与薄放设置相同的帧数. 栏杆会折叠

blocks.en: Uplink and sampling interval. At 3.13 MB per frame and one frame every 5 s, raw capture implies 5.0 Mbit/s per rider, so a 1,000-rider fleet would demand 5.0 Gbit/s. Re-encoding to a 1024 px long edge at JPEG quality 85 cuts the payload by 23 × \times , and a 20 s interval removes another factor of four, bringing the fleet requirement to 54 Mbit/s. Fig. 4 sweeps the interval from 5 s to 60 s against the uplink it implies. Accuracy under spatial blocking stays inside the fold-to-fold spread of the 5 s baseline out to 20 s, where the uplink is already four times smaller, and declines from 30 s. The 20 s setting costs 1.4 accuracy points. A size-matched control at the 5 s cadence tracks the thinned curve over the same range. Compute then becomes the limit: the same fleet emits 180,000 frames per hour, and extracting them at the fastest measured throughput would occupy about 125 A100-class accelerators continuously. At city scale, extraction is a datacentre-class workload at the network edge; the 0.4 ms scoring step can run wherever the attribute vector arrives, including the bicycle.
blocks.zh: 上行和采样间隔. 以每帧3.13 MB和每5 s一帧,生擒意味着每架骑手有5.0 Mbit/s,因此1000个乘车机队需要5.0 Gbit/s. 以JPEG质量85重新编码为1024px长边缘将有效载荷切入了23×\times ,一个20s间隔去除另一个4个因素,使机队要求达到54Mbit/s. 发相. 4从5 s到60 s的间隔 与它暗示的上行链路相对 空间阻隔下的精确度停留在5s基线的折叠至相上方的宽度到20s,其中上行链路已经小了4倍,从30s下降. 20 s 设置成本1.4精确点. 一个大小相匹配的控制 在5 s cadence 跟踪稀疏曲线 在同一范围。 然后计算成为极限:同一舰队每小时出出180,000帧,以所测最快的吞吐量取出它们,将持续占据大约125个A100级加速器. 在城市规模上,提取是网络边缘的数据中心级工作量;在属性向量到来的地方,包括自行车,0.4ms积分阶能跑.

blocks.en: VI Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Experience weighting. Weighting ratings 0.8 to 0.2 in favour of annotators who had ridden the location improves regression MAE from 1.011 to 0.95 and raises accuracy by about two points, but reduces safe-class recall by roughly ten points. It also changes the target scores, so the two are not scored on identical labels; we report the unweighted model as primary.
blocks.zh: 经验分量. 加权评分从0.8到0.2, 支持那些骑过位置的注释者将回归MAE从1.011提高到了0.95, 并且提高了精确度约两分, 但将安全级的召回减少大约十分. 这也改变了目标分数,因此两者在相同的标签上没有得分;我们报告未加权的模型为主.

blocks.en: Limitations. The VLM processes each frame independently and may miss cross-frame context; contrastive prompting across consecutive frames could address this. The dataset covers two routes in inner London, and cross-city generalisation remains to be demonstrated. Annotators cycle at least three times weekly, and familiarity alone moves a rating by 0.121 points, so the model reflects the judgement of frequent local riders. Extending the annotator pool to occasional and non-cyclists is the next step.
blocks.zh: 限制。 VLM 独立处理每个框架,可能会错过跨框架上下文;跨相继框架的对比提示可以解决这个问题。 数据集覆盖了伦敦内地的两条线路,而跨城市通化仍有待展示. 注释者每周至少循环三次,而仅熟悉就移动了0.121分的评分,因此该模型反映了经常出现的地方骑手的判断. 下一步是将注释者池扩大到偶尔的和非自行车手.

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: We presented an edge-assisted crowdsensing system that turns handlebar video into a structured sketch of each scene at the network edge, fuses it with OSM road infrastructure and rider kinematics, and scores perceived safety with an explainable boosting machine. The EBM regressor achieves 72.2% binary accuracy and MAE 1.011 on a 1–9 scale. It stays within one point of the black-box ensembles under random folds, and under spatial blocking no model pair separates. With scoring some 6,000 × \times cheaper than extraction and a 20 s interval serving a 1,000-rider fleet at 54 Mbit/s, the pipeline is a practical basis for continuous safety monitoring. The system gives planners a scale of perceived safety on which to weigh candidate interventions. Neither the structured prompt nor the additive model is specific to cycling, so the same edge-assisted pattern extends to other street-level qualities judged by the people who use the street.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个边缘辅助的人群感应系统, 将手柄棒视频变成网络边缘每个场景的结构化的草图, 将其与OSM路基建和骑手运动仪相接, EBM回转器实现72.2%的二进制精度,MAE 1.011在一至九级. 它停留在随机折叠下黑盒组合的一分之内,在空间屏蔽下没有模型对相分离. 由于得分大约为6,000xxxx时间比取取取便宜,而且一个20分的间隔服务于以54Mbit/s的1000乘车机队,管道是持续安全监测的实际基础. 该系统使规划者有一定程度的感知安全性,可以据此权衡候选干预措施。 结构化的即时和添加剂模型都没有专门针对骑行,所以同样的边缘辅助模式也延伸到了由使用街道的人判断的其他街道级别品质.
